description:
Update an existing address book entry by its ID.

**When to use:** Call this when a saved address needs to be corrected or updated — e.g. a contact has moved, changed phone number, or you need to add delivery instructions. Use `starshipit_list_addresses` first to find the correct `id`.

**Parameters:**
- `id` (required) — the address book entry ID to update (retrieve via `starshipit_list_addresses`)
- `address` (required) — updated address fields; you should provide all fields, not just the changed ones, as the API replaces the entire entry

**Required fields inside `address`:**
- `name`, `street`, `post_code`, `country`

**Optional fields inside `address`:**
- `code`, `company`, `suburb`, `city`, `state`
- `phone`, `email`, `instructions`, `building`
- `carrier`, `signature_required`

**Returns:** The updated address object.

**Errors:**
- 400 — validation failure on the address fields
- 404 — no address with the given `id` was found
- 401/403 — authentication failure

**Example:**
```json
{
  "id": 6926658,
  "address": {
    "name": "Warehouse Manager",
    "company": "Acme Logistics",
    "street": "55 Bourke St",
    "suburb": "Melbourne",
    "state": "VIC",
    "post_code": "3000",
    "country": "Australia",
    "phone": "0398765432",
    "signature_required": true
  }
}
```

code.description: Custom reference code for this address (e.g. "SUPPLIER-001")

instructions.description: Delivery instructions for the courier (e.g. "Leave at front door")

signature_required.description: Whether a signature is required on delivery

id.description: Address book entry ID to update (from starshipit_list_addresses)

name: starshipit_update_address

outputSchema.description: Raw StarShipIt API response; not truncated

errors.description: Validation or processing errors returned by StarShipIt

object.description: The response payload when StarShipIt returns a non-object value

success.description: StarShipIt success flag (a boolean on most endpoints)

title: Update Address Book Entry
